question: When is carbon dioxide produced as a waste product in plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**During respiration.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Respiration is the process of converting glucose into energy in the presence of oxygen.**
 
• **During this process, carbon dioxide is produced as a waste product and released into the atmosphere.**
 
• Plants undergo respiration just like animals, although they also undergo photosynthesis where they produce oxygen and glucose.
 
• **During photosynthesis, plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and release oxygen.**
 
• Transpiration is the process of water loss from plants through the stomata.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas responsible for climate change.**
 
• Plants play a crucial role in mitigating the effects of climate change by absorbing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere during photosynthesis and releasing oxygen.
 
• However, the burning of fossil fuels and deforestation have led to an increase in the concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
 
• **It is leading to global warming.**
